args.text: Can you pull every ticket and feature request on Pellucid Harbor Logistics and Driftmoor Marine Freight from the Coastal channels and Moss's Coastal notes, labelled by account? Leave Pellow Home Living out even though it shares the PHL code. I need the list for Kwame's account review.

Bettina, here's what I found in #coastal-team, #coastal-random and Moss's Coastal digests (plus your Pellucid cutover note). Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark Retail items are left out.

*Pellucid Harbor Logistics*
• #4419: `Yard_Dwell_Summary` report times out when filtered by container length. Still open per the Coastal cheat sheet. See the caveat below.
• PD-8841: chassis pool holds on double-booked gates, Gate 4B. Raised by Hector, night dispatcher at Beaumont. From your 2025-12-08 cutover recap; I can't see a current status.
• No ticket number: CSV import bug on the Berth 2 yard map (04:00 shift change), also from your recap, listed as lingering as of Nov 2025.
• No ticket number: chassis pool validation at Gate 4 during shift change, described as the main friction point (cheat sheet).
• No ticket number: terminal 4 drayage gate export, queued for the 11/3 handoff (Moss digest 2025-11-02).

*Driftmoor Marine Freight*
• Feature request #882: bulk-clear button for departed barges, asked for by warehouse managers (cheat sheet).
• No ticket number: patched manifest CSV requested before the 06:00 shift (Moss digest 2025-11-02).
• No ticket number: tide-table import macro failed on Terminal B, and engineering supplied a manual CSV patch for the night dispatcher (cheat sheet).
• Possibly #4419 again. The 2025-11-02 digest puts #4419 under Kwame's port account, about barge slip 7 schedule sync, next to the Driftmoor item. The cheat sheet puts #4419 on PHL's Yard_Dwell_Summary. One of them has the wrong number or the account mixed up, so please check #4419 with Kwame before the review.

*Left out*
• #8812 (Door 4B scanner) and PD-4821 are Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark.
• PD-4827 and PD-4824 are Saltmarsh Provisions.

A few notes:
• Most of this is dated Oct 2025 to Feb 2026. I found nothing newer on either account, and the Moss notes are digests, not live ticket exports. Statuses may be stale.
• I only searched the channels you're in and the shared notes. I didn't check the ticketing system itself, so anything never mentioned in chat or notes won't be here.

I posted the list in a reply to your message in #coastal-team, grouped by account. I left out the Pellow Home Living / Covey & Lark items (#8812 and PD-4821). I also left out the Saltmarsh Provisions tickets (PD-4827 and PD-4824).

  - Ticket PD-8841: chassis pool holds on double-booked gates at Gate 4B.
  - Three items have no ticket number: the Berth 2 yard map CSV import bug, Gate 4 chassis pool validation at shift change, and the terminal 4 drayage gate export.
- **Driftmoor Marine Freight:**
  - Feature request #882: a bulk-clear button for departed barges.
  - Two items have no ticket number: a patched manifest CSV requested before the 06:00 shift, and the tide-table import macro failure on Terminal B.
- **#4419 conflict:** Moss's 2 Nov 2025 digest puts #4419 on Kwame's port account (Driftmoor, barge slip 7 schedule sync). The cheat sheet puts it on Pellucid. I flagged it for you to check with Kwame before the review.
